validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: extensively, independently documented across a nine-year paper trail, not a GEM-only entity. Traced the sheet's own wiki-cited leads first: the 2017-06-06 APGDC EOI letter to PNGRB (https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/eoi/ng/eoi16/EOI-NG_APGDC.pdf, a scanned image PDF -- url_verifier false-negatives on it since there is no text layer, so I visually read all pages) proposes the Srikakulam-Angul line at an initial ~400 km estimate; PNGRB's 2019-07-23 Schedule D Grant of Authorization (http://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/ngp/Govt-Authorization/gail_08082019.pdf, same scanned-PDF situation, visually read in full) shows the project was ultimately competitively bid and awarded to GAIL (India) Ltd, not APGDC, with an attached time-schedule table giving 390 km main trunk + 300 km spur = 690 km and 6.65 MMSCMD capacity. This 690 km figure is independently corroborated by a 2019-2021-era Ministry of Environment forest-clearance project note (https://forestsclearance.nic.in/DownloadPdfFile.aspx?FileName=0_0_8118122712181Projectnote.pdf&FilePath=../writereaddata/Addinfo/, url_verifier SSL-errors on this host but the PDF was fetched and read directly with pdftotext) which independently states 'approximate length of the SAPL pipeline is 690 kms'. GAIL's own foundation-stone press release (2022-11-12, https://www.gailonline.com/PressRelease12112022.html, PM Modi ceremony) and independent trade press covering the same event (cgdindia.net, 2022-11-10, https://cgdindia.net/union-government-to-lay-foundation-stone-for-srikakulam-angul-natural-gas-pipeline-project/) both confirm the project by name, capacity and cost. Most recently, GAIL's own 2026-01-03 stock-exchange disclosure (reprinted independently by indianmasterminds.com and psuconnect.in, both verified live) states the main line was commissioned 2025-09-26, and PM Modi dedicated it to the nation 2025-10-16 -- independently confirmed by theweek.in's contemporaneous (2025-10-16) coverage of the PM's Andhra Pradesh visit, which names 'GAIL's Srikakulam-Angul Natural Gas Pipeline' specifically as one of the dedicated projects. The Government of India's own National Infrastructure Pipeline portal (https://indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in/opportunities/nip-project/701343) independently lists the project under Central-PSU energy infrastructure with the same Srikakulam(AP)/Angul-Cuttack-Dhenkanal-Khordha-Ganjam(Odisha) route and a June-2026 completion date. This is real, physically-built pipe, not a phantom or a stale artifact. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct -- this is PNGRB's own common-carrier NGPL register (May-2026 MIS report, Sr. No. 9, section: PARTIALLY COMMISSIONED), and every independent source describes it as a cross-state transmission trunk-with-spur system, not a gathering/process line. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=GAIL (India) Ltd 100% is correct and independently corroborated -- the 2019 PNGRB authorization is addressed to and accepted/signed by 'GAIL (India) Ltd.' (Kumar Shanker, Chief General Manager), and GAIL's own 2022 press release describes it as GAIL's project; no source names a co-owner or contradicts 100%. Note the ORIGINAL 2017 EOI proponent was actually APGDC (Andhra Pradesh Gas Distribution Corporation, a GAIL Gas/AP-government JV) -- APGDC filed first, but the pipeline was ultimately authorized to GAIL (India) Ltd itself via a 2019 competitive bid (ref code 'PNGRB/Auth/2-NGPL/BID/SAPL/(5)/2019' -- 'BID' confirms this). No conflict: current Owner1=GAIL (India) Ltd is the entity actually holding the authorization and building/operating the line. StartLocation=Srikakulam (Andhra Pradesh) / EndLocation=Angul (Odisha) is confirmed by every single source above without exception. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 27-pipeline India-gas roster -- no overlap. P6538 'Kakinada-Srikakulam Gas Pipeline' is a genuinely different, adjacent (upstream/feeder) line terminating at the same Srikakulam node (multiple sources describe P0954 connecting to APGDC's Kakinada-Srikakulam line AT Srikakulam), not the same physical pipe.

validity.recommendation: Update LengthKnown from 690.00 to 744.00 km (keep LengthKnownUnits=km). The 690 km figure was the 2019 authorization-stage design length; the actual built/authorized-and-supplemented system is materially longer.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM's current LengthKnown=690.00 traces to the 2019 PNGRB authorization's time-schedule table (390 km main trunk + 300 km spur), independently corroborated at the time by the 2019/2021-era forest-clearance note ('approximate length ... 690 kms'). But every source describing the ACTUAL project scope from the 2022 foundation-stone ceremony onward gives a materially larger figure, consistently, across four years and multiple independent origins: GAIL's own 2022-11-12 press release states 745 km (620 km Odisha + 125 km Andhra Pradesh); cgdindia.net's independent coverage of the same 2022 ceremony also states 745 km; cgdindia.net's separate 2025-06-24 construction-progress article (independent reporting, predates the 2026 disclosure) states 744 km as 422 km main + 322 km spur; offshore-technology.com's trade-data profile (GlobalData network, a separate compiler) independently states '744km-long'; and GAIL's own 2026-01-03 stock-exchange disclosure (reprinted by indianmasterminds.com and psuconnect.in) again states 744 km (422+322). Four independent origins across 2022-2026 converge on ~744-745 km, versus one 2019-vintage design-stage estimate at 690 km -- the current sheet value is stale/superseded, not merely uncertain. Tier=high (>=2 independent, non-derivative sources for the 744 km figure alone, without even counting the corroborating 745 km strand).

validity.recommendation: Re-examine ConstructionYear=2021. No source found supports 2021 as any milestone in this project's history; the best-evidenced construction-start milestone is the PM Modi foundation-stone ceremony on 2022-11-12.
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet carries ConstructionYear=2021 with no ref (MISSING_REF). I could not find any source -- primary or press -- placing a construction-start event in 2021. The documented timeline is: EOI filed 2017-06; PNGRB authorization granted 2019-07-23 (36-month commissioning clock starts here, targeting ~2022); foundation stone/ground-breaking ceremony 2022-11-12 (PM Modi, per both GAIL's own press release and independent cgdindia.net coverage of the same event); mechanical completion of the 422 km main line by mid-2025 (cgdindia.net, 2025-06-24); commissioning 2025-09-26 and PM dedication 2025-10-16. There is a real gap between the 2019 authorization and the 2022 foundation stone -- three years of front-end engineering/land acquisition is plausible but I found no evidence that pipe-laying itself began in 2021. Flagging as a genuine, sourced discrepancy for Update to resolve (either correct to 2022, per the ceremonial/construction-start convention used elsewhere in this batch, or if 2021 reflects some documented pre-ceremony mobilization Update can locate, keep it and add that ref) rather than silently overwriting.

fills.researcher_notes: Diameter was genuinely blank on the sheet (the real gap per the country guidance). This is NOT a single-diameter pipe -- per the 2019 authorization's own time-schedule table it is a mixed system: 24in (135 km) and 18in (255 km) on the main trunk, 18in (50 km) and 12in (250 km) on the spur. Proposing 24 as the single Diameter value per this repo's max-diameter convention for mixed systems, independently corroborated by offshore-technology.com's trade profile ('maximum diameter of 24 inches') -- two independent sources agree on 24in as the maximum, but note it characterizes only ~135 of 744 km (~18%) of the actual system; the majority of pipe is smaller-bore (18in/12in). Medium tier reflects that caveat, not doubt about the 24in figure itself.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Went to the regulator's register first per the country guidance. PNGRB's May-2026 NGPL MIS report files this exact authorisation under PARTIALLY COMMISSIONED (Sr. No. 9, register name 'Srikakulam-Angul', entity GAIL): 470 of 690 authorised km operating, 221 km still under construction (202 km hydrotested, 270 km welded), target completion Jun-26, gas_supplied_mmscmd=0.0 and capacity_utilisation_pct=0.0 as of the report -- i.e. mechanically built but not yet flowing commercial gas on the operating section, per the register's own numbers. This is the classic partially-commissioned pattern this country's guidance warns about (cf. Mallavaram-Bhopal-Bhilwara-Vijaipur/P0938+P3602), except here GEM carries only ONE row (P0954, full 744/690 km) rather than a split operating+construction pair. Independent of PNGRB: GAIL's own 2026-01-03 board-approved schedule revision (reprinted by indianmasterminds.com and psuconnect.in) confirms the 422 km main line commissioned 2025-09-26 but the 322 km spur line is still incomplete (280/322 km done as of the disclosure) with target completion revised to June 2026 -- consistent with, and dated within a month of, the PNGRB register. The Government of India's own NIP portal independently lists the project's completion date as 2026-06-30, matching both. All evidence -- regulator, company disclosure, and an independent government infrastructure portal -- agrees the project as a whole is NOT yet complete, so Status='construction' remains correct for this row as currently scoped (the full authorized system). Evidence date taken as 2026-05 (PNGRB register) since it is the most recent formally-dated snapshot; the Jan-2026 GAIL disclosure and NIP portal are consistent with it. STRUCTURAL RECOMMENDATION (not a Status change, flagging for the redundancy/structural-adjudication step): P0954 currently represents the FULL project as one 'construction' row, but per PNGRB's own register the 422/470 km main line has been commissioned and dedicated to the nation since 2025-09/10 -- a majority of the pipeline's length is, in fact, in service. This country's own convention for exactly this situation (partial commissioning of a phased system) is to split into a companion OPERATING row for the commissioned mainline + a CONSTRUCTION row for the remaining spur, as already done for Mallavaram-Bhopal-Bhilwara-Vijaipur (P0938 operating + P3602 construction). No such split exists for Srikakulam-Angul. Consider creating a new operating row (~422-470 km, StartYear1=2025) and shrinking P0954 to the remaining spur under construction (~221-322 km) -- not actioned here since it is a structural change beyond a single-row field edit, and because the exact operating-vs-under-construction split differs slightly between PNGRB's register (470/221, against the old 690 km total) and GAIL's own main/spur split (422/322, against the new 744 km total); Update should reconcile which framing to use before creating the new row.

summary: P0954 (Srikakulam-Angul): existence/classification/attribution/endpoints all independently confirmed across a 2017-2026 paper trail (EOI, PNGRB authorization, GAIL disclosures, PM dedication, govt NIP portal); no duplicate. Two real spec findings: LengthKnown is stale at 690.00 km (2019 design-stage figure) against a consistent, multi-source 744-745 km as-built figure since 2022 (proposed change, high tier), and ConstructionYear=2021 is unsourced/unsupported -- best-evidenced construction-start milestone is the 2022-11-12 PM Modi foundation-stone ceremony, not 2021 (flagged concern). Status='construction' CONFIRMED against the May-2026 PNGRB register and independent 2025-2026 disclosures (main line commissioned/dedicated Sep-Oct 2025, spur line still ~280/322 km complete, target Jun-2026) -- but flagged a structural recommendation: this country already splits partially-commissioned lines into operating+construction row pairs (Mallavaram precedent) and Srikakulam-Angul has no such split despite a majority of its length being in service. Deep-filled Proposal/Capacity/Length/Diameter/Start refs (Diameter is a max-of-mixed-sizes caveat, 18% of system length).
